content.text: They are getting their money's worth out of you 🤣

I’m glad someone around here thinks I’m earning my keep. There are far too many days I feel like anyone off the street could do my job. Not a whole heap of strategizing going on most days with this group. Teaching and presenting a positive learning environment each and every day is our main goal here as a staff. See you at the park Partner.

I know. Through all of this, your staff’s love for the game is obvious. You guys do not get enough credit for taking this challenge on, knowing full well how painful it will be and even that you may not be here when it comes to fruition years from now. When I return, I hope to get that message across. See you soon.
